title: The Sermon on the Mount: The Beatitudes and Kingdom Laws

questions.question: Seeing the crowds, where did Jesus go up to sit down and teach His disciples?
options: He went up on the mountain
He went up on the roof of the synagogue
He went up into a boat
He went up to Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: He went up on the mountain
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:1 (ESV): "Seeing the crowds, he went up on the mountain, and when he sat down, his disciples came to him."

questions.question: Complete the Beatitude: "Blessed are the poor in spirit..."
options: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
for they shall be comforted
for they shall inherit the earth
for they shall see God
questions.correctAnswer: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:3 (ESV): "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven."

questions.question: Complete the Beatitude: "Blessed are the meek..."
options: for they shall inherit the earth
for they shall receive mercy
for they shall be called sons of God
for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
questions.correctAnswer: for they shall inherit the earth
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:5 (ESV): "Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth."

questions.question: According to the Beatitudes, who shall see God?
options: The pure in heart
The merciful
Those who hunger and thirst for righteousness
The peacemakers
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:8 (ESV): "Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God."

questions.question: Jesus tells His disciples, "You are the salt of the earth." What happens if salt has lost its taste?
options: It is no longer good for anything except to be thrown out and trampled under people's feet
It can be restored by adding vinegar
It is used to fertilize the fields
It is given to the poor as wages
questions.correctAnswer: It is no longer good for anything except to be thrown out and trampled under people's feet
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:13 (ESV): "but if salt has lost its taste, how shall its saltiness be restored? It is no longer good for anything except to be thrown out and trampled under people's feet."

questions.question: Jesus tells His disciples, "You are the light of the world." Where do people put a lamp after lighting it?
options: On a stand
Under a basket
Under a bed
In a closet
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:15 (ESV): "Nor do people light a lamp and put it under a basket, but on a stand, and it gives light to all in the house."

questions.question: What does Jesus say about His purpose regarding the Law or the Prophets?
options: "I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them."
"I have come to replace them with a new law."
"I have come to abolish them completely."
"I have come to teach you to ignore them."
questions.correctAnswer: "I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them."
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:17 (ESV): "Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them."

questions.question: Jesus says that unless your righteousness exceeds that of whom, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven?
options: The scribes and Pharisees
The Sadducees and priests
King David
The angels in heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:20 (ESV): "For I tell you, unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven."

questions.question: Jesus expands the law against murder to include what?
options: Being angry with your brother and insulting him
Hunting animals for sport
Defending yourself in battle
Thinking bad thoughts about strangers
questions.correctAnswer: Being angry with your brother and insulting him
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:22 (ESV): "But I say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother will be liable to judgment; whoever insults his brother will be liable to the council..."

questions.question: If you are offering your gift at the altar and remember your brother has something against you, what should you do?
options: Leave your gift there before the altar and go. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift
Offer the gift quickly, then apologize later
Take the gift back home and offer it next year
Offer double the gift to cover the offense
questions.correctAnswer: Leave your gift there before the altar and go. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:24 (ESV): "leave your gift there before the altar and go. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift."

questions.question: Jesus expands the law against adultery to include what?
options: Everyone who looks at a woman with lustful intent has already committed adultery with her in his heart
Marrying someone from a foreign nation
Speaking to a woman who is not your wife
Having multiple wives
questions.correctAnswer: Everyone who looks at a woman with lustful intent has already committed adultery with her in his heart
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:28 (ESV): "But I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman with lustful intent has already committed adultery with her in his heart."

questions.question: Hyperbolically, what does Jesus suggest doing if your right eye causes you to sin?
options: Tear it out and throw it away
Cover it with a patch
Wash it with hyssop
Close it tightly
questions.correctAnswer: Tear it out and throw it away
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:29 (ESV): "If your right eye causes you to sin, tear it out and throw it away. For it is better that you lose one of your members than that your whole body be thrown into hell."

questions.question: Regarding oaths, what does Jesus say you should let your "yes" or "no" be?
options: "Let what you say be simply 'Yes' or 'No'"
"Swear your 'Yes' by heaven, and your 'No' by earth"
"Confirm your 'Yes' with a written vow"
"Say 'Yes, Lord' or 'No, Lord'"
questions.correctAnswer: "Let what you say be simply 'Yes' or 'No'"
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:37 (ESV): "Let what you say be simply 'Yes' or 'No'; anything more than this comes from evil."

questions.question: In contrast to "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth," what does Jesus teach if anyone slaps you on the right cheek?
options: Turn to him the other also
Strike him back with the left hand
Flee from him immediately
Take him before the judge
questions.correctAnswer: Turn to him the other also
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:39 (ESV): "But I say to you, Do not resist the one who is evil. But if anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also."

questions.question: Instead of hating your enemy, Jesus commands His followers to love their enemies and do what?
options: Pray for those who persecute you
Invite them to supper
Lend them money without interest
Curse them in secret
questions.correctAnswer: Pray for those who persecute you
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:44 (ESV): "But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,"

key_verse_text: "In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father who is in heaven."
